sections.heading: 2. Product Specification
paras: Products shall be manufactured in accordance with the product specifications agreed upon and approved in writing by both parties.

NAME is responsible for reviewing and approving the final product specifications before the start of production, including product composition, ingredients, allergens, nutritional values and other product-related information.

Any changes to the approved product specification requested by NAME shall be subject to the Manufacturer's technical assessment and written approval. Such changes may require a revised price offer and/or an updated production schedule.

The Manufacturer shall not be responsible for any consequences resulting from incorrect or incomplete information provided or approved by NAME, subject to the responsibilities imposed on the Manufacturer by applicable law.

sections.heading: 3. General Commercial Conditions
rows: The price is guaranteed for 6 months from the date of the offer. The price guarantee is confirmed by signing the Order Confirmation within the validity period of the offer.
In the event of sudden and significant changes in market prices, the Manufacturer reserves the right to renegotiate prices with NAME or terminate the concluded supply agreement with 3 months' notice.
4 pallets per product index (per flavour). The date of the first order shall be agreed upon with the Manufacturer.
Order quantities in the final contract
To be agreed upon separately and confirmed in writing by both parties.
Products manufactured in accordance with the approved specifications and confirmed Order Confirmation are non-returnable.
Two options are available: (1) pallet exchange provided by NAME; or (2) pallet reimbursement at EUR 16 per pallet.
By e-mail and Order Confirmation (a document specifying the detailed arrangements).

sections.heading: 4. Additional Notes
paras: The prices quoted in this offer apply exclusively to the product configuration, packaging specifications and conditions described in this offer. Any changes resulting in additional or reduced costs will require a revised price offer.

The price offer applies to standard products with standard packaging. Any changes to the product or packaging specifications, including changes to product weight, packaging dimensions, packaging materials, packaging format or the number of units per outer carton, may require a revised price offer.
Any changes to the agreed product or packaging configuration must be confirmed in writing by both parties before implementation.

sections.heading: 2. Packaging Materials – Ordering and Stock Management

items.text: Each purchase of Private Label packaging materials must be agreed upon between the Manufacturer and NAME.
When placing orders, NAME is obliged to take into account the stock levels of packaging materials held by the Manufacturer.

sections.intro: The minimum and maximum quantities of packaging materials ordered from the printing house are as follows:

itemsAfter.text: NAME is obliged to use the above-mentioned labels, foils and cartons within 12 months from the date of their purchase by the Manufacturer.

If NAME fails to use the packaging materials within 12 months, Piekarnia Galicyjska reserves the right to invoice NAME for all remaining unused packaging materials at their original purchase price, including applicable transportation costs, as well as the costs of disposal and transportation of unused packaging materials, where applicable. The payment term shall be 14 days from the invoice date.
Any subsequent orders of labels, foils and cartons shall be subject to the same conditions, meaning that the materials must be used within 12 months from their purchase by the Manufacturer.

In the event that no order is placed for a particular product within 4 months from the date of the last order, NAME shall be obliged to purchase all remaining packaging materials dedicated to that product at their original purchase price. This includes any applicable transportation costs, as well as the costs of disposal and transportation of unused packaging materials, where applicable. The Manufacturer shall issue an invoice for the above-mentioned costs, with a payment term of 14 days.

In the event of immediate termination of cooperation as a result of the termination of the Agreement by either the Manufacturer or NAME, NAME shall be obliged to purchase all remaining packaging materials dedicated to its products at their original purchase price. This obligation also applies to packaging materials already ordered from the printing house but not yet delivered to the Manufacturer, provided that such orders were previously approved by NAME. All applicable transportation costs, as well as the costs of disposal and transportation of unused packaging materials, where applicable, shall also be borne by NAME. The payment term shall be 14 days from the invoice date.

NAME is responsible for reviewing and approving the final product specifications before the start of production, including product composition, ingredients, allergens, nutritional values and other product-related information.

The Manufacturer shall not be responsible for any consequences resulting from incorrect or incomplete information provided or approved by NAME.

NAME is responsible for providing and approving all packaging artwork, including product descriptions, texts, translations, nutritional information, ingredient lists, allergen declarations, barcodes and other legally required information appearing on the packaging.
The Manufacturer shall review and approve the packaging artwork from a technical and production perspective before printing and production.
Printing of packaging materials and production of products shall not commence until the final artwork has been approved in writing by both parties.

Any changes to the approved artwork requested by NAME after its approval may result in additional costs and changes to the agreed production schedule. All additional costs related to such changes shall be borne by NAME.
NAME shall be responsible for ensuring that all information and claims provided for the packaging artwork comply with the applicable legislation in the destination market.

sections.heading: 5. Product Availability and Commercial Rights
paras: The above-mentioned products constitute the generally available commercial offer of Piekarnia Galicyjska and may be offered to other customers under their own brands, both in the country designated by NAME and in other countries. Any arrangements concerning exclusivity or restrictions on the sale of products to other customers must be agreed upon separately and confirmed in writing by both parties.
